lenses.description: map of kebab-case lens name → absolute path to a .md lens file

lenses_dir.description: optional directory; names not in `lenses` resolve to <lenses_dir>/<name>.md

default_lens.description: lens name used when the worker omits lens

log_path.description: absolute path to the append-only lens_runs.jsonl file

watch_globs.description: fnmatch patterns tested against each written file's path relative to the session working directory AND its absolute path; paths under ~/.claude/ and the system temp directory never match
